# AgriOptima AI

AgriOptima AI is a web platform for agricultural decision support and produce trade in India.

## Main capabilities

- Farmer crop planning using connected farm information
- Plain-language soil health and fertilizer guidance
- Recent mandi price references and produce listing support
- Produce discovery and comparison for buyers
- Quality, order, shipment and payment records
- Interfaces in English and selected Indian languages

## Canonical website

https://agrioptima-ai.vercel.app/

## API

https://agrioptima-ai-r0h2.onrender.com/docs

The platform distinguishes user-entered, externally sourced, estimated and model-generated information. Model recommendations are decision support and should not replace qualified agricultural advice.
